name: Aaron Benzrihem Ankle Pick System
description: Aaron Benzrihem’s ankle-pick course covers standing setups, seated guard, three-point stance and same-side or cross-body finishing topics.
summary: Ankle-pick attacks from standing, seated guard and a three-point stance.
overview: Basics To Advanced: Ankle Picks For Jiu Jitsu treats the ankle pick as both a standing takedown and a seated-guard attack. Aaron Benzrihem covers distance, grips and setups before exploring same-side and cross-body finishes. The range of starting positions makes this relevant to grapplers who want an ankle attack that connects their standing and guard games.

fits: You want ankle-pick setups from standing and seated guard.

includes: Distance, grip choices and standing setups involving feints, trips and collar drags.
Seated entries, combat-base situations and three-point-stance attacks.
limits: This is an ankle-pick course, with gi-grip setups among its material; it does not cover the full range of wrestling takedowns.
